scenes.spoken_text: Scaling large language models pushes infrastructure into a corner. You are fighting a trilemma: more throughput spikes latency, clamping latency inflates cost, and cutting cost wrecks performance.
scenes.visual_directive: Draw a large triangle labeled Throughput, Latency, Cost. Place a red circle at its center labeled The Memory Wall.

scenes.spoken_text: The bottleneck is not compute. It is data movement: every generated token drags the KV cache across the memory wall.
scenes.visual_directive: Draw a GPU box on the left and an HBM box on the right. Connect them with an arrow labeled bandwidth.

scenes.spoken_text: vLLM attacks fragmentation with PagedAttention, paging the KV cache like virtual memory and batching continuously for about 2.4 times the throughput.
scenes.visual_directive: Draw three stacked rectangles labeled pages inside a box titled KV Cache. Add an arrow into them labeled continuous batching.
